EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the rolling hills and lush forests of the kingdom, but something is off. The once-majestic stone walls now seem dull and grey, the flags bearing the royal crest now faded and worn. The king, KING ARIN, sits on his throne, surrounded by his advisors.

KING ARIN
(to his advisors)
I have a vision, my friends. A vision of a new era for our kingdom. An era of... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...futurism.

ADVISOR 1
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty?

KING ARIN
(nodding)
Yes. We will embrace the latest trends from the city. The art of the merchants, the music of the traveling performers... we will incorporate it all into our kingdom.

ADVISOR 2
(alarmed)
But, Your Majesty, our kingdom is a medieval empire. We cannot simply adopt the trappings of the city.

KING ARIN
(firmly)
Nonsense. We will make it work. We will... (he pauses, a look of inspiration crossing his face)...we will make it... (he searches for the right word)...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

INT. CASTLE - DAY

The king's advisors look on in confusion as the king begins to decorate the castle with strange, futuristic-looking artifacts. There are glowing orbs, holographic displays, and strange, pulsing lights.

KING ARIN
(to his advisors)
We will make our kingdom the envy of all the land. We will be the... (he pauses, a look of excitement crossing his face)...the pioneers of vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the castle, now transformed into a surreal, dreamlike landscape. The flags bearing the royal crest now read "Vaporwave Empire" in bold, neon letters. The king's advisors look on in amazement as the king steps out onto the balcony, a look of triumph on his face.

KING ARIN
(to the camera)
Welcome to the Vaporwave Empire. Where the past and the future collide in a swirl of... (he pauses, a look of excitement crossing his face)...futuristic funk.

FADE TO BLACK.

(to Advisor 2)

ADVISOR 2

CUT TO:

The king sits on his throne, surrounded by his advisors. He looks out over the kingdom, a look of pride on his face.

KING ARIN
(to his advisors)
